message.content:
This is a fragrance mist, an alcohol-based preparation sold for retail use on the body. It falls under heading 3303 (perfumes and toilet waters). Within that heading, subheading 3303.00.30 covers perfumes and toilet waters other than those in 3303.00.10 (perfumes) and 3303.00.20 (toilet waters), and 3303.00.30 is the "Other" provision. The 10-digit code is 3303.00.3010 or 3303.00.3000.

The HTSUS lines under 3303 are:
- 3303.00.10.00: Perfumes
- 3303.00.20.00: Toilet waters (not in the 3303.00.10 category)
- 3303.00.30.00: Other

So the line is 3303.00.30.00. CBP rulings on fragrance mists have generally classified them under 3303.00.30 as "Other," since a mist with a lower fragrance concentration is not a perfume or a toilet water. Body mists in rulings of this kind have been classified in 3303.00.30.00. The description of the whipped vanilla and cherry blossom mists matches those rulings. Sets sold together would be classified under GRI 3(b) as a set, and the mists are the same type of product in the same heading, so the heading result is the same.

{"hts_code": "3303.00.3000", "reason": "Alcohol-based fragrance body mists in retail spray bottles are preparations of heading 3303, falling under the 'Other' provision (3303.00.30) rather than perfumes or toilet waters."}
